svg.title: Chapter 5: Five Fixed Points
svg.desc: Chapter 5's card from above: the five sites in an arc at the loop's far end, each lit by its own lantern and the shared fire ring at 22 brightest, carried posts standing in their slots; past 20 and past 24 there is flat black with no ground in it at all. Beside the picture, the map's green legend box keeps its height with 4 of its nine rows printed; Tam's pencil count underneath agrees.
